text_blocks.snippet: Alpha-synuclein is a protein strongly implicated in Parkinson's disease. Misfolding and clumping of this protein into structures called Lewy bodies are a hallmark of the disease and are thought to contribute to neuronal dysfunction and cell death. While the exact physiological function of alpha-synuclein is still being researched, it is known to play a role in synaptic transmission and vesicle trafficking.
